def typed_dict_to_dict(typ: type) -> TypeDict:
    """Convert a TypedDict to a dictionary representation."""
    hints = typ.__annotations__
    return {
        "module": typ.__module__,
        "qualname": typ.__qualname__,
        "elem_types": {name: type_to_dict(field_type) for name, field_type in hints.items()},
        "is_typed_dict": True,
    }


def type_to_dict(typ: type) -> TypeDict:
    """Convert a type to a dictionary representation."""
    if is_typed_dict(typ):
        return typed_dict_to_dict(typ)
    
    module = typ.__module__
    qualname = qualname_of_generic(typ) if is_generic(typ) else typ.__qualname__
    
    result: TypeDict = {
        "module": module,
        "qualname": qualname,
    }
    
    if is_generic(typ):
        args = getattr(typ, "__args__", None)
        if args:
            result["elem_types"] = [type_to_dict(arg) for arg in args]
    
    return result
